integrity: The proof of unbounded-size exhaustiveness uses exact finite-state closure with 758 reachable states, independently cross-checked in a second implementation by direct two-round atomic-pair types. External independent audit has not been performed.
scientific_limitations: The theorem classifies rank-two ordinary first-order equivalence only within binary-coloured oriented cycles of length at least three; it does not concern unrestricted digraphs, stronger logics, or rank three and above. Unindexed earlier tabulations remain a novelty risk.
title: Exactly forty-eight rank-two theories of binary-coloured directed cycles
